name: Radiomics Feature Selection Benchmark
description: Compares feature selection methods on radiomics (tabular) datasets to evaluate selection quality and downstream predictive performance.
reputation: A niche academic benchmark used in radiomics and feature-selection research for comparing selection methods and downstream predictive performance.
notes: Often uses small, heterogeneous medical cohorts — high risk of overfitting and dataset-specific biases; results require careful cross-validation and clinical validation; non-LLM, classical ML focus.
